title: 用量批次冪等、亂序缺口、衝突稽核與簽章檢查點恢復 (Idempotent Usage Ingest, Contiguous ACK, Conflict Audit & Signed Checkpoint Recovery)
expected: POST /api/v1/agent/usage-batches enforces idempotent batch replay, per-event duplicate/conflict/rejected status, contiguous ACK watermark (highest_contiguous_seq & blocked_seq), >2^53 decimal string precision, and Ed25519-signed GET /api/v1/agent/usage-checkpoint recovery with fvpn-usage-admin freeze/begin-recovery/complete-recovery.
actual: Live mTLS /api/v1/agent/usage-checkpoint and /api/v1/agent/usage-batches on serving node 01a1962d-cf63-7872-883e-fd4e6d9dbd0f (incarnation 01a1962d-d142-7ee5-a86f-045b8774d67e, initial real agent seq=5) verified Ed25519 recovery signature, out-of-order seq {6,8} -> gap fill seq 7 advancing highest_contiguous_seq to 8, batch replay and duplicate retry with zero double-counted bytes, payload_sha256 conflict audit (usage_event_conflicts=1), rejected seq 10 (>2^53 decimal string 9007199254740993) reporting blocked_seq=10 then advancing to 11, 409/403 error guards, and live fvpn-usage-admin freeze/begin-recovery/complete-recovery rotating ledger_epoch 24f58a61-72e1-4f33-b641-4c1f430818fc -> 01a19638-365e-7ac4-a729-c4d3d513da02 with replay_unavailable reconciliation to seq 12.

mechanism_checks.name: ContiguousAckAndDecimalStringPrecisionAbove2Pow53
mechanism_checks.summary: Out-of-order sequences {1, 3} hold highest_contiguous_seq at 1 with missing_ranges=[{2,2}] until seq 2 arrives (advancing to 3); 2^53+1 (9007199254740993) and 2^53+3 (9007199254740995) round-trip as exact decimal strings.

mechanism_checks.name: DuplicateBatchLostAckAndConflictBlockedSeq
mechanism_checks.summary: Batch resends and lost-ACK retries never double-count bytes; conflicting payload_sha256 records usage_event_conflicts and rejected events set blocked_seq=6 while holding highest_contiguous_seq=5.

mechanism_checks.name: CentralDBRestoreSignedCheckpointAndReplayReconciliation
mechanism_checks.summary: FreezeIngest returns 503; BeginRecovery rotates ledger_epoch with a signed PurposeLedgerEpoch record; old epoch batches return 409 LEDGER_EPOCH_MISMATCH; Ed25519-verified PurposeRecovery checkpoint guides replay_unavailable tombstone reconciliation without inventing bytes.
